scope: Small feasibility pilot after quality/protection screening; original target 160/80/80 not achieved.
selection: No correct/wrong quota; random role assignment before base predictions.
target_control: Identical visual facts, rule and application sentences. Structured targets only add section labels. This tests formatting, NOT baseline-length preservation or longer reasoning.

generation.paired_control: Exactly zero A/B adapter, same native adapter request path as trained weights. Adapter-free native baseline is descriptive only.

gates.train: Fixed first 40 training IDs in dataset lock; generation seed 0; at least +10 percentage points vs paired base. Evaluate all checkpoints, no development scores for failing checkpoints.
gates.development: For train-passing checkpoints, 40 development examples, seeds 0/1/2: mean at least +5 percentage points, each seed >= paired base. Manually check evidence/answer consistency.
gates.selection: Among passing checkpoints, highest development mean; ties earlier step, lower learning rate, then prose before structured.
gates.stop: If no checkpoint passes, record failure and do not evaluate confirmation or official MMMU.
gates.confirmation: Chosen recipe repeated with training seeds 1,2; fixed checkpoint step. Confirmation40 with generation seeds0/1/2: overall mean +5pp and each training seed mean>=base; no reselection.
gates.official: Only after confirmation passes, fixed training seed0 model, MMMU validation900 x5 generation seeds. Zero-delta native adapter controls must use the same engine configuration; old64.93 is historical context only if complete parity is not established.

uncertainty: Paired question bootstrap; exploratory model selection; no guaranteed statistical power; original development40 already informed annotation strategy.
preflight_timing_note: An eight-training-example, 256-token greedy engine-parity probe was already running. Its accuracies were not used to choose roles, recipes or gates.
control_amendment: Before any SFT training and before inspecting full-length baseline results: use zero-delta native adapter as primary paired control to isolate adapter dispatch from learned weights. Greedy eight-example comparison is only an engineering check.
